create_xxhash32: create a 32-bit xxhash digest from a string or bytes input
create_xxhash64: create a 64-bit xxhash digest from a string or bytes input
test_xxhash32: test the xxhash32 function with string and bytes inputs
test_xxhash64: test the xxhash64 function with string and bytes inputs
run_xxhash: run xxhash32 and xxhash64 to generate hash digests from data
